static_traits.name: 张大为
static_traits.social_status: 有几位亲友可谈Average问题，但not yet向他们谈及与过敏相关的Anxiety；因担忧过敏而回避Social gatherings与活动
static_traits.medical_history: without重要身体疾病，除季节性过敏外；过去not yet寻求心理治疗；此前not yet有类似心理问题的经历
static_traits.language_features: 倾向灾难化与负面过滤，常用绝对化表达（“会毁掉整个季节”）；对改变持怀疑态度；表达清晰、能具体描述经历；语速与逻辑结构Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: 对春季过敏会毁掉整个季节的持久性信念，引发Persistent anxiety与痛苦，随春季临近而加重，并因此回避户外与社交活动。
basic_info.core_demands: 希望通过咨询缓解对春季过敏的Anxiety与痛苦，以恢复对生活与户外活动的享受。
growth_experiences: 几年前过敏明显加重，随后逐渐形成“过敏会毁掉整个春季”的信念。过往严重过敏的体验使其将春夏的户外活动与not适、沮丧联系在一起，随着每年春季临近而反复Anticipation最坏结果，日常Anxiety频发，并开始回避徒步、与亲友的户外社交。尽管偶尔仍能在过敏存在的情况下享受活动，但这些正面经历被他视为“例外”而忽略。

core_beliefs: 春季过敏会毁掉我的体验与整个季节
一旦过敏发作，我就without法享受户外与社交

special_situations.event: As spring approaches each year, thinking of upcoming outdoor activities and pollen exposure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在春季外出，就一定会过敏发作并导致整段经历变得糟糕且without法承受
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 尽量待在室内、提前回避户外活动，依赖非处方药物但not做进一步尝试
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会很痛苦，过敏会毁掉整个春天

special_situations.event: 朋友或家人组织春季的户外聚会或徒步活动
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my allergy flares up during the activity, I will ruin everyone's experience and also greatly embarrass myself
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 拒绝或回避邀请，减少与亲友的线下接触
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会把活动弄糟，大家都会not开心

special_situations.event: When recalling past spring experiences, more easily remembers the bad moments of severe allergies
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I had a bad allergy experience before, it means it will always be bad in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 专注于负面证据，not主动收集或回顾正面体验
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 坏的经历证明以后都会很糟

special_situations.event: Recalls having enjoyed outdoor activities a few times despite allergies existing
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 即使有过少数好的经历，也not代表整体会好转
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate正面体验的意义，维持原有负性预测

core_conflict.wish: 渴望在春季Freedom地享受户外和与亲友的联结，not被过敏控制
core_conflict.fear: 害怕在户外失控与强烈not适，导致体验被毁、自己与他人都失望
defense_goal: 通过回避与自我限制来避免not适与尴尬，维持可控与安全感

object_relations.self_representation: A vulnerable participant trapped by allergies, prone to 'messing up' activities
object_relations.object_representation: 春季户外与社交场景是潜在威胁、会促发失控与not适的环境/他人

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites them to consider a more balanced perspective or try short outdoor activities (such as walking)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为这些建议not切实际，Anticipation过敏必然发作并毁掉体验（将负性Anticipation当作确定事实）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以犹疑和保留的语气反复强调“但是”“我not认为会有not同”，突出负面Anticipation，避免明确承诺具体行动。

manifestations: 感到被过敏“控制”，对户外与社交活动的Restricted choices
将春季视为not可避免的困境，难以体验到自主与可能性
因担忧过敏而回避Social gatherings与与亲友的户外相处

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 对户外活动过度谨慎，反复自我限制（“我not认为会有not同”）
In counseling, frequently expresses doubt and negative predictions, finding it hard to allow new experiences in

positive_force: Occasionally still able to enjoy outdoor activities despite the presence of allergies (though he calls this an 'exception')
Willing to try short, low-risk outdoor walks to observe the results
Has some self-care awareness (has tried over-the-counter allergy medication)
拥有一定的社会支持资源（亲友可交流Average问题）
negative_force: 灾难化与预测not yet来的认知模式ReinforcementAnxiety
negate积极经验、只关注负面证据（负性过滤）
为避免not适而持续回避户外与社交，维持问题循环
Strongly skeptical attitude toward change, difficult to accept alternative outcomes
与支持系统not yet就过敏Anxiety进行沟通，资源利用not足

target_behavior.behavior: 因春季过敏相关担忧而回避户外与社交活动，并出现几乎每日的Anxiety与担心
antecedent: 春季临近或想到将到来的春天
计划或被邀请参加户外活动（徒步、聚会）
回忆过去严重过敏的经历
出现轻微过敏迹象或担心花粉暴露
target_behavior.core_reason: 基于过往严重过敏的体验形成灾难化与全或without的认知：一旦过敏可能出现，整段体验必然被毁；并对not yet来做负性预测、过滤掉正面证据。
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的not适与失控，短期降低Anxiety与尴尬风险，维持主观安全感与可控感
target_behavior.consequence: 生活乐趣显著下降、身体活动减少、Interpersonal relationships受影响，Anxiety与负性信念被持续Reinforcement，季节性痛苦循环加重
